name: swarm of ravens
desc: Swarm of Ravens is a CR 0.25 beast.

actions.name: swarm
actions.desc: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.desc: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=pyvvXqoxJsjkkP38]], one creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s space.
